spans.s: कुमत् a word containing a guttural letter in it;.cf. कुमति च
कुमार (1) Kārtikeya who is believed to havegiven inspiration to the Kat- antra-sūtrakāra to write the Kātan- tra-sūtras; (2) named Viṣṇumitra who wrote a commentary on the ऋक्प्रातिशाख्य,
कुमारीस्तनयुगाकृति a phrase used in the gloss on the कातन्त्र by Durga- siṁha to give along with the defi- nition of र्विसर्जनीय or विसर्ग a graphic description of it as shown in script cf. Kāt,
कुमुदादि a class of words (१) consisting of कुमुद, शर्करा, न्यग्रोध etc. to which the taddhita affix ठक् is applied in the four senses given in

-70; e.g. कुमुदिकम्,शर्करिकम् etc(2) consist- ing of कुमुद गोमय, रथकार etc to which {{RunningHeader||center=| 116 right=कृत}'} the taddhita affix इक ( ठक् ) is applied in the senses referred to in (I): e.g. कौमुदिकम् , राथकारिकम् etc.; cf. Kāś, on

कुम्भपद्यादि a class of words headed by कुम्भपदी in which the word पाद at the end of the compound is changed into पाद् and further chan- ged into पद् before the feminine affix ई; e.g. कुम्भपदी, शतपदी, द्रुपदी, पञ्चपदी etc.; cf Kāś. on
